notes.title: 📢❗🚨 Kebabstar Prologue is NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
The Kebabstar Prologue is Available NOW!

      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677598/ef01fe940016c70c05606110e0a472e08afda138.png"]

Hey, stars! 🌟

The moment we've all been waiting for is here! We are thrilled to announce that the free Kebabstar Prologue is now available for everyone to play! 


What's in the Prologue?


In this introductory chapter, you will get a taste of the core mechanics of the Kebabstar universe:

🌯Art of the Kebab: Involved with your real hands to make delicious kebabs ever you never made it before!

😎 Glasses: You are AI Agent but you don't know what it is supposed to be? What is the behind of the exile from desert?

💼 Truth of the Businessman: Find the Atilla's letter in Grand Bazaar's luxury jewelry shop to find the information about the Bearded One.

This is just the beginning! By playing the prologue, you can provide us with valuable feedback and get a head start as an experienced AI Agent when the full game launches.


Download and play for free right now!



And don't forget to add the full game to your wishlist and follow us our main game to keep updated!

Happy cooking!

notes.title: 3️⃣ Days Until Kebabstar: Prologue 🎮🔥
notes.content:
3 Days Until Kebabstar: Prologue 🎮🔥


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677598/a836f57d47f2cad1fb187a141771906130c7c7c0.png"]



In just 3 days, Kebabstar: Prologue will let players step into this unique adventure blending cooking simulation with humor, creativity, and unexpected twists.



Boran is not your usual chef.



Glasses on.



His camel is missing...



A cult is waiting in Cyprus.



And his only weapon… is his mastery of kebab.



Prologue is coming.

notes.title: KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE: RELEASE DATE 🔜 1️⃣5️⃣ AUGUST
notes.content:
🎉 KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE COMING IN 15 AUGUSTGet ready for a free culinary adventure! 

KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE is launching on August 15th!  

Embark on an exciting journey through the first three chapters, each bursting with unique flavors and vibrant settings. First, spice things up in Arabian Deserts, where luxury party meets with the Boran's destiny. Then, experience the modern Beach Of Dubai. Finally, immerse yourself in the rich history and bustling energy of Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, a crossroads of cultures and tastes. 

Mark your calendars! 🗓️ 

This mouthwatering prologue is just the beginning!🎮
